repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
h1 = (#Bedroom_HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity
delay(30 MIN)
h2 = (#Bedroom_HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity
diff = h2 - h1
if (diff >= 15) {
(#Bedroom_Dehumidifier).switch_on()
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate incorrectly computes the absolute difference between humidity readings, whereas the IR specifies a signed difference ($h2 - $h1). The IR only triggers the action if the humidity dropped by at least 15 units (h2 < h1 - 15). The candidate's logic `if (diff < 0) { diff = h1 - h2 }` converts a drop into a positive value, causing the condition `diff >= 15` to trigger on a drop, which is the opposite of the IR's intent. Evidence F2 confirms an extra action was emitted when the IR emitted none.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value logic. The script now directly computes `h2 - h1` and checks if it is greater than or equal to 15, preserving the IR's requirement that the action only fires when humidity increases significantly.
